title: Model training acceleration method and system for federal Internet of things system

pse.problem: Inefficient model training in federated IoT systems due to large variations in client data attributes and non-independent/identically distributed data.
pse.solution_function: The method optimizes federal learning aggregation by considering the characteristics of data distribution for each client. It improves convergence speed by reducing time consumption during model training.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of federated IoT clients and a server. Each client has a model and powerful sensors (cameras, microphones, GPS, etc.).
pse.solution_implementation: During the t-th round, each client sends its locally trained model to the server. The server aggregates the received models using an optimized scheme that considers the data distribution of each client. This can be done through custom weighting strategies for each co-located parameter or for parameters of identical positions across all models.
pse.effect: The optimized method accelerates the convergence speed of the models, reducing time consumption during model training and improving the expression of models on federated learning clients.
